summary: `GET /v1/administration` (the full linked-administrations list) is accountant-only and returns EP_001 for every non-accountant token -- the majority of real accounts -- so a command that surfaces it must treat that error as an expected, gracefully-degraded case, not a fatal one.
reason: The OpenAPI spec does not document this scoping. Discovered live: `administration overview` aborted entirely for a normal (non-accountant) token instead of still rendering the balance/outstanding figures that work for everyone. Losing this behavior on a regen would silently reintroduce a command that fails for most real users.
validated_outcome: Verified live against a real non-accountant token: EP_001 on the administrations sub-call is swallowed, Administrations field stays nil, and LinkedAdministrations + balances + outstanding figures still render.
